title: Japanese Ramen with Braised Pork
description: A Chinese-inspired recipe featuring braised pork and a flavorful ramen broth.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp of sesame oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork cubes until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add 1 tbsp of shoyu to the pot and stir to combine. Scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot.
Add the sliced onion and cook until caramelized, about 8 minutes.
Add the sliced ginger, minced garlic, and cooked pork back to the pot. Stir to combine.
Add 4 cups of water to the pot and bring to a boil. Cover and transfer to the oven.
Braise the pork in the oven at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until tender.
While the pork braises, cook the ramen noodles according to package instructions.
To assemble the ramen, place a portion of noodles in a bowl and top with a slice of braised pork, some green onions, and a splash of shoyu.
